text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day before the Debut Race. I had arranged to meet up with Mejiro Bright and the others
to observe a Mejiro family event, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When the meeting time arrived, Mejiro Bright was nowhere to be seen...
After an awkward silence with Mejiro Dober that stretched for nearly thirty minutes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, just the two of you?
You two are getting along so well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We are not...! Bright, you're late...
Wait, that doll... isn't that "Maki-chan"? Why do you have it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is indeed Maki-chan~. Since it is such a special occasion,
I thought she might like to watch Ryan-onesama and the others' gallant display too~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh* Fine, I get it. You were late because you were getting that doll ready.
Everyone else has already left for the venue, so let's catch the train and follow them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
All right~... *achoo*.
Phew~... It almost feels as though snow might fall~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was that some kind of omen...? On our way to the venue, snow began to fall.
The sudden shift in weather, plunging us back into the dead of winter, disrupted transit everywhere—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—Huh?! McQueen and the others
haven't arrived yet...?!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Due to traffic jams caused by the sudden snow, the cars aren't moving at all...
Running here would be dangerous, so it seems they're heading over by train now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
B-But then they won't make it in time for the start, right...?
It starts in five minutes, and there are so many fans waiting...

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Let us explain the situation to the fans and ask for their patience.
I'm sure they will understand. Though it will leave them waiting with nothing to do for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I understand.
In that case... shall the two of us have a little chat on stage~♪?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...? ...Wait, what?!
Are you saying we should go up there and buy time...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Inexperienced though we may be, we are still members of the Mejiro family.
Surely that would be more enjoyable for the fans than simply waiting in silence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That might be true, but... there's no way I can do that!
I mean—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—I wonder what they're going to talk about...
It's so rare to see them all gathered together like this...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I knooow~. We'll be able to gaze upon their gorgeous faces any second now...
Ah, I have to burn this image into my retinas and my brain...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...No way! In front of that huge crowd...?
I... I can't speak out there...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I understand that this is an ordeal for you, Dober.
However, I surely cannot manage the conversation all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I need your help.
We just need to chat like we always do... all right~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If it were just talking, I could do it, but... I'd have to look at all those fans, right?
...I'm sorry. I just don't have the confidence after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, it's all right~.
I am right here with you~. So everything will be just fine~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I suddenly notice something. Mejiro Bright's hand, resting on Mejiro Dober to encourage her,
is trembling ever so slightly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady McQueen, Sister Ryan, and all the others...
I am certain they would handle this with poise and adaptability. In which case, we too must—
choice_data_list: (She's actually nervous too. But even so—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —We must do so, to become a new light for the Mejiro family...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she's determined to be the one to support the next generation of the Mejiro family.
No matter the situation, she strives to stay true to her ideals. If that's the case—
choice_data_list: (I want to help her realize that dream.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...However, I cannot force you.
Very well, I shall go out alone—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Hello, everyone, it is a pleasure to meet you~♪
My name is Mejiro Bright. And this is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Right, 'Maki-chan'~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ............'I'm Maki-chan. Nice to meet you...'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, those girls haven't debuted yet... right?
Are they like the opening act?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan B
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, 'Maki-chan' is... that's Dober-san, isn't it?
Is this a puppet show...? What an unusual approach.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—Talk through a doll?!
Doesn't that just make things way harder...?!
choice_data_list: But you won't have to look directly at the fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The suggestion made to the two was to conduct their talk with the doll Mejiro Bright brought along.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By introducing the doll, the audience's gaze would be dispersed away from Mejiro Dober...
and by speaking through the doll, she herself could avoid feeling scrutinized.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...B-But... what if even after doing all that, I completely mess up
and drag the Mejiro family name through the mud...?
choice_data_list: Bright is with you, so you'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright loves the Mejiro family more than anyone. With her by her side,
there's no way their reputation will be tarnished. And above all—
choice_data_list: You two are proud Mejiro horsegirls, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Interim Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Our Interim Trainer is quite right. I will be right by your side.
I certainly won't let you burst into tears, Dober~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna cry over this! ...All right, fine.
I want to pull my own weight, too... so I'll give it my best...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Sister Ryan took me by the hand
and ran alongside me. She was so very dashing~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
'Yeah... Ryan really is cool.
Ever since way back, she's always looked out for everyone... and she's still so humble.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~. Everyone in the Mejiro family has been wonderful since childhood...
We hope to become just like them someday, wouldn't you agree, Bel-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... 'Hey, wait! I'm Maki-chan!
How many times are you gonna mess that up?!'

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Haha...! They're both so adorable~♪
I see, it's like a comedy routine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Dober, Bright... You both proved quite dependable.
We owe you a great debt. Though... why the doll?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep everyone waiting!
Leave the rest to us from here on out—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the arrival of today's stars brought the venue to an even greater fever pitch.
Mejiro Bright and Dober had succeeded in brightening up the event magnificently.
